pages.title: Build a Warper
pages.text: Make a Warper in the Constructor or Auto Constructor using a rare Warper blueprint: 8 Ender Pearls, 2 Advanced Circuits, 2 Flux Capacitors, 8 Silver Ingots, 4 Platinum Ingots, 4 Lithium Ingots, 8 Silicon Dust, 16 Negarite Dust and 16 Posirite Dust.$(br2)This produces one fresh Warper. Name and configure it with a Teleportation Card as described on the following pages.

pages.title: Record destinations
pages.text: Make a Teleportation Card in the Constructor using its blueprint: 4 Ender Pearls, 2 Silver Ingots and 1 Circuit. There is no crafting-table recipe.$(br2)Name a Warper in its hologram, then sneak-right-click it with the card to record its name, coordinates and dimension. A card holds up to 64 destinations.

pages.title: Choose and preview
pages.text: Right-click the card to open its hologram. Select a destination from the paged list to capture a rotating 3D preview of the surrounding 32 by 32 area, even in another dimension.$(br2)Selecting refreshes the name and checks the destination. A removed Warper cannot receive travelers. Replacing it at the same coordinates restores the address on existing cards.

pages.title: Redirect a Warper
pages.text: Right-click a different Warper with the configured card. A smaller rotating preview appears above the pad; walk into it to teleport. Mobs and dropped items can also travel. Keep the arrival space clear.$(br2)Setting a destination never starts an expiry timer. After successful travel, it clears 30 seconds after the last teleport. Each successful teleport restarts that delay.

pages.title: Pin, clear and name
pages.text: Right-click the Warper to name it, Clear its card destination, or Pin it permanently. Unpin restores expiry based on the last teleport, so an already elapsed delay clears it immediately.$(br2)With Ariente World installed, charged Overworld and Ariente Warpers keep their Warp to Ariente / Warp to Overworld buttons and return-trip behavior. Card destinations also work without Ariente World and in other dimensions.
